title.narrative: Mitigating the impact of winter conditions on underserved populations in Quneitra sub-district through a multisectoral approach to resilience (objective 1 and 2)

description.narrative: ltpgtThe project targets populations in Quneitra and Khan Arnaba sub-districts in Quneitra governorate, which are underserved locations with high needs and limited humanitarian assistance across sectors and therefore prioritized in this allocation (inter-sector severity score 3, winter severity index 3.2). Proposed interventions will complement previous and current assistance provided to the same target population and support them through a comprehensive approach aimed at directly increasing the thermal comfort of households (HHs) susceptible to harsh winter conditions and sustainably increasing their resilience to winter conditions through agricultural livelihood opportunities and access to safe drinking water and sanitation. The project targets 25,787 women, men, girls, and boys, including the most vulnerable groups in Quneitra and Khan Arnaba sub-districts.ltbrgtMinimizing vulnerable HHs’ exposure to harsh winter conditions is considered a lifesaving activity and a priority by the NFI Sector under objective 1. In response to priority needs and eligible winterization activities, this activity will provide three rounds of environmentally friendly heating fuel (olive pomace) to 800 of the most vulnerable HHs in Al Hameidiyyeh (Quneitra sub-district) in the period Nov. 2023 till Feb. 2024. (activity completed before revision request)ltbrgtIncreasing resilience against future winters to the same communities that ZOA targets under objective 1 through agricultural livelihood and WASH assistance is considered a life-sustaining activity and prioritized by the FSA and WASH sectors under objective 2. In response to priority needs and eligible sectoral activities in the strategy, and complementing WFP efforts in distributing food rations to the most vulnerable households, ZOA will solarize a drinking water well in Al Hameidiyyeh which was rehabilitated by UNICEF through SARC 3 years ago. The solarization will address the inadequate provision of drinking water to the network due to lack of electricity from the public grid, especially in the winter season when the consumption of electricity increases. To complement, ZOA will provide further critical agricultural inputs to 300 vulnerable farmers according to their needs and preferences, and a fixed budget of 200 USD per farmer. (activity completed before revision request)ltbrgtDue to security changes in the Quneitra sub-district as of January 2025, ZOA is not able to start the rehabilitation of the initially selected nursery well and sewage network in Quneitra sub-district. The Israeli Defence Forces (IDF) have erected barriers in front of the selected nursery well and at the entrance to Al Hameidiyyeh village, preventing access. As a result, ZOA relocated these activities to Khan Arnaba sub-district after coordinating with the relevant local authorities and receiving their confirmation of the need. ZOA will thus restore and solarize a currently non-functioning agricultural water borehole that reaches a public nursery in Khan Arnaba and rehabilitate a damaged sewage network in the same location. The rehabilitation of the sewage network will stop contamination of living environments . The implementation duration for all FSA and WASH activities under objective 2 is 12 months.ltbrgtActivities are designed in line with the HNO, the HRP objectives, the current allocation strategy paper and recent needs assessments among the target population, and in close coordination with the Directorate of Agriculture (DoA), the General Sewage Company (GSC), the Directorate of Social Affairs and Labor (DoSA) and DoWR in Quneitra as well as the Sectors of Shelter/NFI, WASH and FSA.ltbrgtInterventions will jointly contribute to saving lives, alleviating suffering and maintaining human dignity for target populations and to their early recovery through an integrated response of immediate winter NFI support, enhancing livelihood opportunities and reinforcing sustained access to critical WASH services, in particular during winter months.ltbrgtlt/pgt
